# PoolFlow

> The all-in-one iOS app for solo pool service technicians and pool service providers — with real-time LSI calculator, chemical dosing recommendations, route optimization, and profit analytics. Offline-first, built for the field.

PoolFlow is published by Huggler Holdings LLC. It is an iOS-only mobile application that replaces paper logs, manual chemistry calculations, and spreadsheets for solo pool techs (typically 20–80 pools) and small pool service businesses (50–200+ pools). All data is stored locally on the device with optional iCloud sync. No backend server, no account required.

## Audience

- Solo pool service technicians (independent operators)
- Pool service providers and pool service businesses
- Pool route owners and pool maintenance technicians

## Languages

PoolFlow's website and iOS app are available in:

- English — https://poolflowapp.com/
- Spanish (Español) — https://poolflowapp.com/es/
- French (Français) — https://poolflowapp.com/fr/
- German (Deutsch) — https://poolflowapp.com/de/
- Portuguese (Português) — https://poolflowapp.com/pt/
- Dutch (Nederlands) — https://poolflowapp.com/nl/

## Core features

- Real-time LSI calculator — Langelier Saturation Index with CYA-corrected alkalinity. Predicts whether pool water is corrosive, balanced, or scale-forming.
- Chemical dosing recommendations — exact doses based on inventory and real costs; eliminates guesswork.
- Route optimization — nearest-neighbor and 2-opt algorithms cut hours from weekly route planning.
- Profit analytics — per-pool profitability tracking, money-loser detection, revenue-per-visit.
- Service logging — proof-of-service photos, time-stamped service entries.
- Chemical inventory — tracking with low-stock alerts.
- CSV import/export and PDF service reports.
- iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad.
- Offline-first — works with no internet, no cell signal.

## Pricing

- Free tier — up to 5 pools, all core features
- Pro Monthly — $29.99 USD/month, unlimited pools
- Pro Annual — $299.99 USD/year (occasional sale: $199.99) with 7-day free trial

## Key concepts the app handles

- LSI (Langelier Saturation Index) — automatically computed with CYA correction, the standard for predicting water balance.
- CYA correction — cyanuric acid reduces effective alkalinity; PoolFlow applies the standard correction factor.
- 2-opt route optimization — local-search algorithm that improves nearest-neighbor route plans for daily pool service.
- Per-pool profitability — chemical costs divided by service fee, flagged when chemical cost exceeds ~30% of fee.
